enchants.SW.Enchantment.SoulInfusedPotion: Drinking a health potion grants additional souls, and allows potion use even at full health.
enchants.SW.Enchantment.Arcane: Using an artifact grants the Arcane status, reducing artifact cooldown while increasing artifact damage and soul collection.
enchants.SW.Enchantment.PotionBarrier: Drinking a health potion creates a protective barrier that reduces incoming damage for you and nearby allies.
enchants.SW.Enchantment.MultiPotion: Grants additional health potion uses and a chance to immediately restore a potion charge.
enchants.SW.Enchantment.PotionSharing: Drinking a health potion creates a restorative spring that heals you and nearby allies.
enchants.SW.Enchantment.ChainReaction: Fired arrows have a chance to trigger a chain reaction, shooting five additional arrows in all directions on impact.
enchants.SW.Enchantment.Unstoppable: Charges forward like an unstoppable stampede, knocking back and trampling through enemy hordes.
enchants.SW.Enchantment.Blowback: Creates a shockwave upon landing or striking that knocks back and stuns nearby enemies.
enchants.SW.Enchantment.CriticalQuiver: Empowers your quiver, increasing critical hit chance and multiplying damage dealt by arrows.
enchants.SW.Enchantment.Dynamo: Rolling adds bonus damage to your next melee or ranged attack, stacking with each roll.
enchants.SW.Enchantment.Borealis: Leaves explosive Ender mines when rolling that detonate upon enemy contact.
enchants.SW.Enchantment.ExpandedQuiver: Increases maximum arrow capacity and grants a chance to generate special Ender arrows.
enchants.SW.Enchantment.FireAspect: Ignites enemies on hit, dealing continuous burn damage over time.
enchants.SW.Enchantment.FrostCrescent: Unleashes a sweeping crescent of biting frost that slows and damages foes in front of you.
enchants.SW.Enchantment.GravityPulse: Periodically emits a gravitational pulse that pulls nearby enemies toward you.
enchants.SW.Enchantment.Radiance: Attacks have a chance to spawn a circular healing area that restores health to you and allies.
enchants.SW.Enchantment.HealthSynergy: Activating any artifact instantly restores a percentage of your maximum health.
enchants.SW.Enchantment.Channeling: Channels lightning from above, striking struck enemies with a bolt of electric burst damage.
enchants.SW.Enchantment.Piercing: Arrows pierce through targets, traveling in a straight line to strike multiple enemies.
enchants.SW.Enchantment.PoisonFog: Defeating an enemy leaves behind a lingering toxic cloud that poisons and damages foes within.
enchants.SW.Enchantment.LingeringPower: Defeating enemies or consuming buffs increases your attack damage for a short duration.
enchants.SW.Enchantment.Ricochet: Arrows have a chance to ricochet off impacted targets and walls to hit additional nearby foes.
enchants.SW.Enchantment.ShadowStrike: Entering stealth or striking from shadows deals massive bonus damage.
enchants.SW.Enchantment.GuardingStrike: Defeating an enemy grants a brief shield that reduces incoming damage by a significant percentage.
enchants.SW.Enchantment.Shockwave: The final attack in a melee attack combo unleashes a forward shockwave that damages all enemies in its path.
enchants.SW.Enchantment.MultiRoll: Grants additional roll charges before triggering the roll cooldown.
enchants.SW.Enchantment.SoulFireAspect: Consumes gathered souls to unleash searing soul fire bursts on hit.
enchants.SW.Enchantment.SpringLoaded: Boosts movement speed and lengthens roll leap distance after performing evasive maneuvers.
enchants.SW.Enchantment.Swirling: The final attack in a melee combo performs a 360-degree sweep, damaging all surrounding foes.
enchants.SW.Enchantment.TempoTheft: Attacking an enemy steals their movement speed, slowing the target while speeding you up.
enchants.SW.Enchantment.Thundering: Attacks have a chance to summon chain lightning that arcs between nearby enemies.
enchants.SW.Enchantment.BurstBowstring: Rolling automatically fires arrows at up to three nearby enemies without consuming ammunition.

effects.Acrobat: Reduces roll cooldown time, allowing more frequent dodges.
effects.Aim: Improves projectile zoom, velocity, and aiming accuracy.
effects.Alchemist: Each soul absorbed restores a portion of your maximum health.
effects.Ally: Emits an empowering aura that boosts damage and defense for you and nearby allies.
effects.Assassin: Increases the likelihood of landing lethal critical strikes.
effects.Bounty Hunter: Deals increased damage against enemies that have already taken damage.
effects.Bowyer: Rolling discharges a burst of arrows in all directions.
effects.Brawler: Widens the reach and damage of sweeping melee attacks against groups of mobs.
effects.Bully: Deals bonus damage against enemies that are stunned, frozen, or slowed.
effects.Cooldown: Reduces the cooldown time of all equipped artifacts.
effects.Critical Hit: Increases the chance of landing a critical hit on attack.
effects.Cryomancer: Increases frost damage dealt and prolongs chill and freeze durations.
effects.Deflection: Grants a chance to deflect incoming projectile attacks back at enemies.
effects.Duelist: Deals extra damage when engaging a single isolated enemy.
effects.Electromancer: Increases lightning damage dealt by attacks, enchantments, and artifacts.
effects.Elemental Protection: Reduces incoming damage taken from fire, lightning, poison, and frost.
effects.Evasion: Grants a chance to completely dodge and evade incoming enemy attacks.
effects.Finesse: Increases melee attack accuracy and combo attack speed.
effects.Fletcher: Grants a chance to replenish arrows upon hitting enemies.
effects.Healer: Increases all healing received and given to allies.
effects.Impact: Increases base attack impact and staggering force against enemies.
effects.Knockback: Increases the distance enemies are pushed back when struck.
effects.Looter: Increases the drop rate of consumables, potions, and items from defeated enemies.
effects.Luck: Increases luck, improving the chances of finding rare and unique equipment.
effects.Marksman: Increases ranged weapon damage and arrow flight velocity.
effects.Momentum: Consecutive attacks build momentum, increasing your attack speed with each strike.
effects.Pack Leader: Increases the damage, movement speed, and resilience of summoned companions.
effects.Persistence: Increases attack damage when health falls below 50%.
effects.Point Blank: Arrows and ranged attacks deal significantly more damage to enemies at close range.
effects.Potion Maker: Decreases the cooldown period between health potion uses.
effects.Precision: Increases critical strike chance on ranged attacks.
effects.Prickly: Reflects a portion of damage taken back to the attacker.
effects.Projectile Protection: Reduces damage taken from enemy ranged projectiles and arrows.
effects.Prospector: Increases the chance of finding emeralds when defeating mobs.
effects.Protection: Reduces all incoming damage by a flat percentage.
effects.Prowler: Increases movement speed while sneaking or in stealth mode.
effects.Pyromancer: Increases fire damage dealt and extends burn effect duration.
effects.Quiver: Expands maximum quiver capacity, allowing you to carry more arrows.
effects.Raider: Increases emerald collection yield from chests and fallen enemies.
effects.Ranger: Grants a chance to fire multiple arrows simultaneously with each shot.
effects.Reaper: Increases soul gathering rate when defeating enemies.
effects.Recovery: Reduces delay before health regeneration begins after taking damage.
effects.Regeneration: Continuously regenerates a percentage of health every second.
effects.Reload: Increases bow drawing speed and crossbow reload rate.
effects.Resilience: Reduces the duration of harmful status effects inflicted on you.
effects.Shackler: Attacks have a chance to chain groups of enemies together, locking them in place.
effects.Sharpness: Increases base melee weapon attack damage.
effects.Sharpshooter: Fully charged ranged shots deal bonus damage and knock back targets.
effects.Shepherd: Increases health and defense of sheep, llamas, and other pasture companions.
effects.Sniper: Ranged attacks deal exponentially more damage the further the target is.
effects.Sorcerer: Empowers magic artifacts, increasing damage and area of effect.
effects.Soulmancer: Increases damage dealt by soul artifacts and soul abilities.
effects.Stealth: Rolling or sprinting briefly shrouds you in shadows, making you harder to detect.
effects.Strength: Boosts physical attack power and melee stagger.
effects.Tainted: Defeated enemies explode in a toxic burst, damaging nearby adversaries.
effects.Totem Radius: Expands the radius and effective area of all deployed totems.
effects.Vanguard: Increases attack power and armor when surrounded by multiple enemies.
effects.Venomancer: Increases poison damage dealt and extends poison duration on afflicted enemies.
effects.Veterinarian: Healing you receive is partially shared with all active companions.

gear.SW.Item.Artifact.FlameSceptre: Hold to channel soul energy, unleashing a fiery inferno that incinerates nearby foes.
